description: 45° chamfer at the mouth of the four insert holes, from Ø4.0 to Ø5.0 mm, so heat-set inserts start centred and upright: on the r04 print, inserts set with a soldering iron ended up off centre and the lid screws were hard to start. Only the body changed; lid, board carrier and USB cover are identical to r04.

hardware.lid: 4 M3x8 screws + 4 M3 heat-set inserts in the columns
hardware.board_carrier: none: drops onto the floor pins, held by the lid
hardware.cable_gland: 1 M8x1.25 cable gland (2 to 4 mm cable)
hardware.antenna: bulkhead SMA connector in the 6.8 mm hole, IPEX 1.0 pigtail

limits: Insert hole Ø4.0 x 6.5 mm, chamfered to Ø5.0 at the mouth, sized for an M3 insert 5.7 mm long and Ø4.6 outside; check against the insert used.
The 0.5 mm chamfer is a design choice, not yet printed: check that the insert starts centred.
USB-C height above the board and how far it overhangs the edge are estimates.
No tested sealing: the lid has no gasket; use under cover.
The battery cable and the antenna pigtail are not modelled.
Pin clearance (0.2 mm on the radius) and lid post clearance (0.3 mm) untested: with the lid open the carrier only rests on the pins.
RST and USER buttons are not dimensioned in the datasheet: position, protrusion (0.8 mm) and height estimated from the drawing scale; check with calipers.
Cable gland nut modelled as a Ø14 x 4 mm cylinder, not measured on the actual part.
USB cover held by friction only (0.1 mm clearance per side on the width and 0.15 mm on the height); untested.
The I²C adapter of the sensor cable has no fixed place in the enclosure yet.
